issue_context.body:
## Description
## Bug Report

MySQL

```
mysql> SELECT DISTINCT BIT_OR( '11:34:28.039509' ) AS field1 FROM `table1000_int_autoinc` WHERE CASE ( `col_char_255_key` >> -9218868437227405312 ) WHEN ( ( SUBTIME( '2016-02-13', `col_set` ) ) < 'k' ) THEN `col_enum` END GROUP BY ROW_COUNT();
--------------
SELECT DISTINCT BIT_OR( '11:34:28.039509' ) AS field1 FROM `table1000_int_autoinc` WHERE CASE ( `col_char_255_key` >> -9218868437227405312 ) WHEN ( ( SUBTIME( '2016-02-13', `col_set` ) ) < 'k' ) THEN `col_enum` END GROUP BY ROW_COUNT()
--------------

Empty set, 2456 warnings (0.01 sec)
```

TiDB

```
mysql> SELECT DISTINCT BIT_OR( '11:34:28.039509' ) AS field1 FROM `table1000_int_autoinc` WHERE CASE ( `col_char_255_key` >> -9218868437227405312 ) WHEN ( ( SUBTIME( '2016-02-13', `col_set` ) ) < 'k' ) THEN `col_enum` END GROUP BY ROW_COUNT();
--------------
SELECT DISTINCT BIT_OR( '11:34:28.039509' ) AS field1 FROM `table1000_int_autoinc` WHERE CASE ( `col_char_255_key` >> -9218868437227405312 ) WHEN ( ( SUBTIME( '2016-02-13', `col_set` ) ) < 'k' ) THEN `col_enum` END GROUP BY ROW_COUNT()
--------------

ERROR 1105 (HY000): expected integer
```

comments:
Yet another:

```
mysql> SELECT DISTINCT MAX( TIME( 'p' ) ) AS field1 FROM `table10_int_autoinc`;
--------------
SELECT DISTINCT MAX( TIME( 'p' ) ) AS field1 FROM `table10_int_autoinc`
--------------

ERROR 1105 (HY000): expected integer
```

I got the other error message:
```
ERROR 1105 (HY000): baseBuiltinFunc.vecEvalInt() should never be called, please contact the TiDB team for help
```

It seems that it's introduced by https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/20221.
```
		eType := expr.GetType().EvalType()
		if expr.GetType().Hybrid() {
			eType = types.ETInt
		}
```
It changes the evalType, but the fucSig is only for string, result in `baseBuiltinFunc.vecEvalInt() should never be called`.
The issue has been removed from the challenge program.

> Yet another:
> 
> ```
> mysql> SELECT DISTINCT MAX( TIME( 'p' ) ) AS field1 FROM `table10_int_autoinc`;
> --------------
> SELECT DISTINCT MAX( TIME( 'p' ) ) AS field1 FROM `table10_int_autoinc`
> --------------
> 
> ERROR 1105 (HY000): expected integer
> ```

I've fixed this as well, but TiDB will produce `00:00:00` instead of `NULL` of MySQL, this is a known compatibility issue, see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/19158 , so I will not touch it.
